extName.description: The extension name, shown in the browser's extension list and on the store listing. A product name is not translated, so every locale repeats it verbatim.

extDescription.message: Capte le trafic réseau, la sortie console et les erreurs JS sur les domaines que vous désignez, et vous rend un rapport Markdown.
extDescription.description: The one-line description Chrome shows under the name. Chrome caps it at 132 characters and silently rejects longer ones at submission, so a translation shortens rather than expands.
